title: Heiser affirms the Watchers and their giant offspring

tellings.quote: Heiser would have affirmed and did that the the Anakian tale that we talked about earlier

plain: The late Bible scholar Michael Heiser accepted the old story of the Watchers, fallen angels who are said to have fathered a race of giants, and the related tale of the Anakim, giants named in the Bible. A researcher named Tim Alberino says this, summarising Heiser's view as he understands it, with reference to Heiser's book The Unseen Realm and Alberino's own work Reversing Hermon. He tells it to show that a serious scholar treated the giants of scripture as real.
